Question stem:
Answer the following question. Submit one photograph showing your constructed graph and your written response together.

Stimulus:
Researchers genotyped a beetle population before and after a pesticide was introduced. Complete a segmented bar graph using relative frequencies of each genotype for each time point. Then identify which time point has the larger relative frequency of the resistant (RR) genotype.

| Time point | RR | Rr | rr |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Before | 10 | 30 | 60 |
| After | 55 | 35 | 10 |

Question stem:
Answer the following question. Submit one photograph showing your constructed graph and your written response together.

Stimulus:
Ecologists recorded rabbit population size and available forage biomass across nine sample plots. Construct a scatterplot, sketch a reasonable trend line, describe the direction, form, and strength of the association in context, and explain what this relationship suggests about forage biomass as a limiting resource for the rabbit population.

| Forage biomass (kg/hectare) | Rabbit population size |
| --- | --- |
| 10 | 24 |
| 20 | 13 |
| 30 | 21 |
| 40 | 18 |
| 50 | 46 |
| 60 | 49 |
| 70 | 33 |
| 80 | 50 |
| 90 | 43 |
